_comment: The example for the local, gitignored `fixtures.local.json`. Copy this file to `fixtures.local.json` in the workspace root and put a real work's URL under each site you want to test. Every URL here is an obvious placeholder, not a work: a live test takes the first entry under a site that fits the shape it needs and skips, printing a note, when nothing is configured. No committed test reads `novel18` or `h_syosetu` — those buckets are for a work you want to fetch by hand. The real file must never be committed: no work's address, title or prose belongs in the repository.

narou.note: a general-audience work; any number of chapters

novel18.note: an adult work on the R18 sibling host; no test reads this bucket

kakuyomu.note: a work; one with more than a hundred episodes also exercises the snapshot regression test

h_syosetu.note: an adult work on the R18 sibling host; no test reads this bucket

pixiv.note: a work; a series with pictures in its chapters also exercises the download test
